description.zh: 当前网关设备的IotId。IotId是物联网平台为设备生成的唯一标识符。可调用[QueryDevice](~~69905~~)接口查询。
description.en: The IotId of the current gateway device. IotId is the unique identifier (UUID) assigned by the IoT Platform to the device. You can call the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) API to query it.

description.zh:
边缘实例的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover your mouse over the name of the target edge instance to view its ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to obtain the ID.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances. For Enterprise instances, this parameter is required.

description.zh: 要替换的新网关设备的IotId。IotId是物联网平台为设备生成的唯一标识符。可调用[QueryDevice](~~69905~~)接口查询。
description.en: The IotId of the new gateway device to replace the current one. IotId is the unique identifier (UUID) assigned by the IoT Platform to the device. You can call the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) API to query it.

title.zh: 替换已绑定到边缘实例网关
title.en: Replace the Gateway Attached to an Edge Instance

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件

- 替换网关前，必须先在物联网平台控制台的**边缘计算** > **边缘实例**> **实例详情**页面重置边缘实例。

- 单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为20。

    > RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Conditions

- You must reset the edge instance on the **Edge Computing** > **Edge Instances** > **Instance Details** page in the IoT Platform console before replacing the gateway.

- The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API under a single Alibaba Cloud account is 20.

    > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot replace-edge-instance-gateway --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id G4TGWGYwpo8zwr000000 --current-gateway-id oTCJomvT95WPyPPQ5sje000000 --new-gateway-id 65SkFyhZcU5d3PO2Ri13000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot ReplaceEdgeInstanceGateway --region cn-hangzhou --CurrentGatewayId oTCJomvT95WPyPPQ5sje000000 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --InstanceId G4TGWGYwpo8zwr000000 --NewGatewayId 65SkFyhZcU5d3PO2Ri13000000
